descriptionHtml:
With the organization of IEEE WIE Affinity Group of University of Peradeniya "SHE will rise ", Women’s day celebration program was held on 8th March 2021 from 5.10 pm onwards via zoom.
The event was carried out by two influential female speakers Dr. Malka Halgamuge from University of Melbourne and Ms. Randhula Gunawardhana from SLIIT.
